title: Resource Archive Extraction Pipeline

units.title: BIG DAISHOWA + REGO-FIX + Tooling Systems + CAMFIX
source_files: BIG DAISHOWA High Performance Tooling Solutions Vol 5.pdf

units.notes: Orange Vise extracted: 44 entries (7 vises, zero-point, tombstones, soft jaws, subplates, jaw plates, fixture plates) → workholding-catalog.ts + 64 tests. Metalmorphosis: actually IMCO end mill catalog (misclassified), excluded.

phases.title: Forge-Triple: Wire New Extractions into PRISM

units.title: New engines from catalog data + tests + dispatcher wiring
Registry enrichment — merge extracted data into existing registries
Tribal knowledge extraction — practical tips from catalog application notes
units.notes: 15 tips (TK-RX-001..015) extracted from Fusion360 + hyperMILL roadmap parameter tables. Covers: radial engagement by material, trochoidal life multipliers, barrel cutter benchmarks, surface finish targets, collision avoidance priority, strategy selection by wall angle, stock-to-leave by tolerance, rest machining detection, steep/shallow boundaries, morphing spiral entry, swarf cutting, impeller sequencing, scallop height formula, FCEOM corner engagement, high-feed milling parameters.

priority_order: P1 (tool catalogs) → P2 (holders/workholding) → P3 (machine models) → P4 (CAM algorithms) → P5 (integration)
